title: High-score Worker operations
description: The routes the Shatterbelt Worker answers; everything else under its routes is a static asset.

entities.name: Open the game
entities.description: The game's page, for players who are signed in.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net with the games:play role (AUTH.requireRole).
entities.result: The page from the static assets, marked Cache-Control: private, no-cache.
failures: Signed out, or the login service out of reach: a redirect to /auth/sign-in that returns to the same address, ?match=ID included.

entities.name: Issue a game's seed
entities.description: Starts a game that may later enter the table, solo or online.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net with the games:play role (AUTH.requireRole, with api: true).
entities.result: { id, seed }: a random UUID and 32-bit seed, stored as unused. Unused seeds older than 24 hours are deleted on the way.
failures: Not signed in: 401; signed in without the role: 403.

entities.name: Submit a game
entities.description: Puts a finished game's named players on the table, after replaying it.
entities.transport: POST /games/retro/shatterbelt/api/score with { id, recording: { mode, players, steps, log }, names }
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net with the games:play role (AUTH.requireRole, with api: true). Any signed-in player may submit a game for every player in it: online, the host's browser sends everyone's names.
entities.result: The seed is marked used, and each player with a name and a score above 0 is stored with the replay's score and wave under the cleaned name. Returns { results: [{ player, score, wave, name, rank }] } for every player, name and rank null for those not entered.
failures: Not JSON, an id over 64 characters, a names list not one per player, or a name with nothing usable or over 200 characters: 400.
A seed that is unknown, used or older than 24 hours, or claimed by another submission meanwhile: 409.
A recording that is malformed or does not replay exactly one whole game from the issued seed: 422.
Not signed in: 401; signed in without the role: 403.

entities.name: Read the table
entities.description: The best ten scores, as JSON for the game's title screen.
entities.result: { scores: [{ name, score, wave, mode, players }] }, best first, ties oldest first.

entities.name: Show the scores page
entities.description: The best 25 scores as a web page in icelander.net's look.
entities.result: An HTML page: rank, pilot, score, wave and the kind of game (Solo, Co-op or Versus with the number of players), with names escaped; no-store, with its own content security policy.
failures: A database error: 500 { error: "server error" } as JSON.

entities.name: Redirect the old address
entities.description: Sends the game's first address to its current one.
entities.transport: Any method on icelander.net/retro-games/shatterbelt and every path under it
entities.authorization: None: answered before any sign-in check.
entities.result: 308 to https://icelander.net/games/retro/shatterbelt with the same rest of the path and query, Cache-Control: no-store; the method is kept.

relatedViews.relationship: The capabilities these operations belong to.
The use cases whose steps call them.
